basic_details.short_information: The Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports, Government of India, is engaging 01 Consultant Grade-II on a contractual basis in the Integrated Finance Division (IFD)/Budget Division, New Delhi. content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates must apply in the prescribed format, the "Application Form for Engagement as Consultant Grade-II" printed with the notice, against "Post Applied For: Consultant Grade-II (IFD/Budget Division)". Applications must be submitted in the prescribed format. Incomplete applications or applications received without the requisite supporting documents shall not be entertained. The notice does not mention a subject line for the e-mail.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: One post of Consultant Grade-II is advertised. Its eligibility and terms as printed in the notice: Essential Educational Qualification: Graduate in any discipline from a recognised University/Institution. Essential Experience: Minimum five years of experience in any field, including at least three years of experience in Government. Desired Experience: More than three years of experience in budget-related work in a Government Ministry. Upper Age Limit: 40 years. The notice does not mention a cut-off date for age or any age relaxation. Monthly Remuneration: ₹55,000/- per month, as per the extant guidelines of the Ministry. Tenure: Initially for a period of two years, extendable by one year at a time, subject to functional requirement and satisfactory performance, in accordance with the extant guidelines of the Ministry. Place of Posting: Integrated Finance Division (IFD)/Budget Division, Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports, New Delhi. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: MYAS Consultant Grade-II Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected Consultant Grade-II shall be required to assist the Integrated Finance Division (IFD)/Budget Division in the following matters: Monitoring of expenditure in accordance with the approved Monthly Expenditure Plan (MEP)/Quarterly Expenditure Plan (QEP). Preparation of Annual Budget Estimates (BE) and Revised Estimates (RE). Preparation and coordination for Budget Estimates (BE)/Revised Estimates (RE) meetings. Timely processing of proposals relating to supplementary grants. Monitoring of savings and ensuring avoidance of excess expenditure. Preparation of Detailed Demands for Grants. Preparation of various budget-related documents, statements and reports. Handling audit-related matters, including examination and preparation of replies to audit observations. Processing of re-appropriation proposals and surrender of savings. Preparation of explanatory notes in respect of savings/excess expenditure exceeding ₹100 crore. Management and monitoring of PFMS, Union Budget Information System (UBIS), NPS/UPS-related matters and coordination with the Controller General of Accounts (CGA)/Ministry of Finance (MoF). The Consultant shall also perform any other duties relating to budgetary and financial matters as may be assigned by the competent authority from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Part E of the application form lists these enclosures: Self-attested copy of Date of Birth Certificate. Self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates. Self-attested copies of experience certificates. Self-attested copy of identity proof. Updated Curriculum Vitae/Resume. Any other relevant document(s).

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MYAS Consultant Grade-II Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 (One) post of Consultant Grade-II in the Integrated Finance Division (IFD)/Budget Division, though the number of positions may be increased or decreased depending on the Ministry's requirements.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for MYAS Consultant Grade-II?
faq.answer: The application should reach the Department within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement dated 20 November 2026, which is about 05 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for MYAS Consultant Grade-II?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Graduate in any discipline from a recognised University/Institution.

faq.question: Q4. How much experience is required for the Consultant Grade-II post?
faq.answer: A minimum of five years of experience in any field, including at least three years of experience in Government, is essential. More than three years of experience in budget-related work in a Government Ministry is desired.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for MYAS Consultant Grade-II?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of MYAS Consultant Grade-II?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration is ₹55,000/- per month, as per the extant guidelines of the Ministry.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for MYAS Consultant Grade-II?
faq.answer: Send the application in the prescribed format, with self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates, experience certificates and other relevant documents, by e-mail to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. Is the MYAS Consultant Grade-II post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely contractual, initially for two years and extendable by one year at a time, and confers no right or claim for regular appointment in Government service.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA shall be admissible for attending the interview or joining the assignment.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the MYAS Consultant Grade-II be posted?
faq.answer: The place of posting is the Integrated Finance Division (IFD)/Budget Division, Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports, New Delhi.
